qualifies_reason: Independently published Canadian trade title issued twice a year, with the Summer 2026 awards annual on sale; note it is an awards-driven industry magazine rather than a consumer title.
what_it_is: Applied Arts is a Canadian trade magazine for the visual communications industry: advertising, graphic design, photography and illustration. Issued twice a year (summer and winter), each edition is largely an awards annual showing the winners of the magazine's own competitions, with a few interviews and editorial features on creative practice; the Summer 2026 issue runs more than 150 pages of award-winning work. It is bought by designers, art directors, photographers and marketing professionals, mainly in Canada.
